name: EK-RA6M5
description: Feature-packed RA6M5 (200 MHz Cortex-M33, TrustZone) kit with J-Link OB, Ethernet, USB FS/HS, CAN FD transceiver, 64 MB Octo-SPI and 32 MB Quad-SPI flash, and Arduino/Pmod/mikroBUS/Qwiic/Grove connectors.
notes: Order code RTK7EKA6M5S00001BE. Four 40-pin headers give native access to the 176-pin MCU. Three user LEDs (red/blue/green), two user buttons; the kit includes micro-USB cables and an Ethernet cable.

flashMB = 2 MB internal + 32 MB QSPI + 64 MB OSPI as listed by Renesas; Zephyr's page lists the QSPI as 32 MB (256 Mb), so the OSPI size is the least certain figure. $54.38 is Renesas' budgetary price; DigiKey lists about $60. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
